title: Outstanding tech, steering, and comfort
summary: The fragments consistently describe the car as outstanding, especially for technology, steering feel, and safety-comfort attributes, but all sampled reviews are labeled undetermined rather than assigned a clear sentiment class.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments praise overall ownership, in-car technology, steering feel, and safety-comfort qualities without enough context to reclassify them into a clearer sentiment category.

limitations: All sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, so the topic cannot be summarized through clear positive, negative, mixed, or neutral sentiment categories.
Several fragments are very short or incomplete, which limits confidence about the precise aspect being discussed.
The examples are stratified samples and are not representative estimates of the full review population.
